A '''records vault''' in the [[Moraine Gulch]], a section of the [[Gorinth Canyon]], was overrun by [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] of [[Darth Zash]] exterminated the Colicoids in order to retrieve information from the vault.
